name: Zinc
description: Tailwind CSS's zinc neutrals with a zinc-600 accent and a violet secondary.

provenance.attribution: Tailwind Labs, Inc., Tailwind CSS v3.4.17's zinc and violet color scales, under the MIT License.
provenance.derivation: anchor-v1 from Tailwind CSS v3.4.17 zinc-50, zinc-900, zinc-600, and violet-600 (light) and zinc-950, zinc-50, zinc-400, and violet-400 (dark). zinc-950 is in Tailwind CSS from v3.3.0.

fallbacks: High contrast renders the sets high-contrast-v1 derives from each base set, and print renders the light set.
